title: Give the agent one verb to upgrade an open work record and move its status
action: pwr-1 made the hook open a work record in status "open" carrying the user's own words. D1's second half is still missing: the agent has no way to say what "done" means for it, or to move it off open — so every record sits open forever and D2's promotion rule (a stub becomes a board card once it carries an acceptance) can never fire. Add ONE verb group, `bee work`, with two shapes: `bee work show [--session S] [--json]` reads the current record, and `bee work set [--acceptance A] [--status S] [--session S] [--json]` writes the acceptance, the status, or both. Follow the group pattern the other native verbs use — try_native returning None for any shape it does not serve, pre_json_scan/parse_flags/keys_known, g_prelude for the root and drift preamble, ctx.emit for success and ctx.fail for a typed refusal. Sink parity with the hook: --session wins, else a herded pane (the herding worker marker plus BEE_HERDING_JOB_ID) addresses its job mailbox, else CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID; the sessions sink writes under the same sessions store lock the hook takes, re-reading inside it. Refusals, all typed and zero-mutation: no work record for the resolved session (say that a prompt opens one); neither --acceptance nor --status given; a --status outside open|active|done|dropped, naming the legal set; an empty or whitespace-only acceptance. D5 reaches the acceptance too, but as a REFUSAL not a redaction — the prompt is the user's text and bee stores what it must, while the acceptance is the agent's own sentence and a secret in it is a bug to report, not to swallow. The registry has no generator any more (the regen line in registry_contracts.rs names node scripts/export_registry_payload.mjs, which is not in the tree): declare both commands by hand in generated/registry_payload.json, written off the real argument parsing exactly as commit e8bc86f7 did for the herding verbs, and add the group to router.rs's PORTED list.

truths: bee work set --acceptance writes the acceptance onto the open record and bee work show reads it back
bee work set --status moves the record through open, active, done and dropped, and refuses any other value by naming the legal set
A status the agent set is not reopened by a later prompt: a record that is no longer open makes the next prompt open a fresh one
Every refusal is typed, names its fix, and writes nothing
A secret-shaped acceptance is refused, never stored and never redacted
A herded pane reads and writes its job mailbox, never a session file
Both commands appear in the embedded registry and the registry suites stay green
